name: tao-skill-bank
description: NVIDIA TAO skill bank for application workflows, model fine-tuning, AutoML, data processing, and platform execution.

interface.shortDescription: TAO app workflows, model actions, and AutoML
interface.longDescription: A local Codex plugin that exposes NVIDIA TAO application workflows, model fine-tuning actions, AutoML, data utilities, and platform skills from this repository. Capability answers should enumerate the application workflows under applications/, describe model train/evaluate/inference/export/TensorRT engine generation support from the packaged schema manifest, list supported execution platforms through scripts/list_tao_platforms.py, and list AutoML-capable models only through bundled scripts that validate models/<network>/schemas/train.schema.json.
defaultPrompt: What can the TAO Skill Bank do?
List TAO application workflows and model actions.
Train a TAO model using the skills in this repo.
Choose the right TAO workflow for my dataset.
Explain which TAO skill fits this task.
